svg.aria-label: Four levels of freedom for an agent, from suggesting only to acting on its own. The course kits sit on the third: pre-approved tools run, anything else asks first

g.text: Says what it would do. You do it.
Each step waits for your yes.
Approved commands just run. Anything else asks.
Nothing asks. Only for a folder you can afford to lose.

svg.text: More freedom: faster, and more for you to check
